lead: A former village at the northern edge of the city, on the other side of the motorways.
text: Vallbona is a small neighbourhood, of 1,440 inhabitants in 0.61 km², on the northern outskirts of Barcelona, separated from the rest of the city by the motorways and linked to Torre Baró by a bridge. It was a small village until the mid-20th century, when much of it was demolished and the Rec Comtal canal was almost entirely covered over. The Pla de Barris 2025-2028 provides for 7 million euros to renovate the five public schools of the northern part of Nou Barris (Zona Nord), including those of Vallbona, and to turn them into instituts escola (all-through schools).

At 1,697 €/m² and 698 €/month, it has the lowest sale prices in Barcelona. It is a very specific option: there is very little housing, and it is worth visiting the area and checking the transport links carefully before deciding. If you are selling, the average sale price is 43% below the Nou Barris average. Within the neighbourhood, the price of each flat depends on its condition, its floor and its building, so it is best to compare it with nearby sales rather than with the district average. If you are buying, an 80 m² flat costs about 136,000 € on average, and this is one of the most affordable neighbourhoods in Nou Barris (13th of 13 by price). If you are investing, the average rent is 12% below the district; before deciding, it is worth studying each deal with real figures for purchase, renovation and rental income.
housing: Housing from the mid-20th century that replaced part of the old village, in a small enclave.
